<!-- pr-reviewer: 6875dfc8853546121b48aa33eb17ccc74c222caa -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review of the 2D Contour whole-model generator change. I merged `upstream/main` (`c414608701df4317220b8078b727dd2d56a52b14`) into the PR head locally with no conflicts and no GitHub runner.

What looks good:

- `note_rings_without_floor` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs:152`, merged `:153`) checks each outer ring in the shared `Some(0)` band arm when the band emits passes.
- Each outer ring that stops at `z_next` with an empty trimmed ladder gets a visible note. The note names the ring point and the uncut Z range (`Z <z_next> and Z <ceiling>`).
- `note_rings_without_floor` writes only to `lead_notes` (`Toolpath.notes`). Toolpath moves, lead moves, and posting code do not change.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs` stays under 400 lines (370 lines after the merge).
- `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole_no_floor.rs` puts the two new pins in a 154-line file with the `Gate map:` header and a provenance comment.
- `docs/decisions/2538-contour-ring-no-floor-note.md` records the design choice and the test-file split.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()` occurs in the new generator code; indexing uses `.get(li)` and `.first()`.
- No `.nc` or `.cl` goldens change, no `crates/ui` files or snapshot PNGs change, and no dependency, `build.rs`, script, or workflow file changes.

Results locally (merged with `upstream/main` `c414608701df4317220b8078b727dd2d56a52b14`, `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 6 steps, 0 failed (`wall 9.0 min`).
  - `motion build (--no-run)`: passed (163s).
  - `camcraft-motion --lib`: 443 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored (370s).
  - `camcraft-motion --test contour_tab_height`: 10 passed, 0 failed.
  - `camcraft-motion --test contour_whole`: 8 passed, 0 failed.
  - `camcraft-motion --test contour_whole_new_outline`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
  - `camcraft-motion --test contour_whole_no_floor`: 2 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Independent mutation checks on `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole_no_floor.rs`:
  1. Remove the `note_rings_without_floor` call at `contour_whole.rs:283`: both pins fail (`left: 0`, `right: 1`).
  2. Remove `!trimmed.ring(li).is_empty()` at `contour_whole.rs:162`: both pins fail (`left: 2` and `left: 3`, `right: 1`).
- After restoration (`git status --short` clean), `contour_tab_height` (10), `contour_whole` (8), `contour_whole_new_outline` (5), and `contour_whole_no_floor` (2) all pass.

Requested before merge:

none.

Questions / notes (not blocking):

- `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole_no_floor.rs` pins two outer rings where both stop at `z_next`. No test in this file yet mixes an outer ring that walks `z_next` with an outer ring that has no floor level (`lad.walks(li, z_next)` guard at `contour_whole.rs:161`).
- `Some(j)` (`j >= 1`, `contour_whole.rs:307`, merged `:312`) does not call `note_rings_without_floor`. When one outer ring in a `Some(j)` band gets a floor `f` below `remaining[j - 1]` and a second outer ring stops with no floor and ends at or above `f`, `next_region` skips the intermediate band and the second ring gets no note. That pre-existing case is outside the two arms named in #2538.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
